briefs.city: The City of Toronto received 122,782 requests through 311 in the last 90 days, with 62.1 percent completed and 46,578 still open. The oldest open request, a Property Standards and Maintenance Violation, is 89 days old, and overall volume is down 3.5 percent from the prior 90-day period. The top five request types were General Pruning at 5,632, Property Standards and Maintenance Violations at 4,979, Long Grass and Prohibited Plants on Private Property at 4,746, Tree Emergency Clean-Up at 4,578, and Residential Bin Lid Damaged at 4,534.
